title: Industrial Additives
description: Specialty industrial additives to enhance performance, stability, and quality of coatings, plastics, lubricants, and process chemicals across Oman and the GCC.

details.longDescription: Industrial Additives supplier in Oman — Global Chemicals LLC supplies a wide range of specialty chemical additives for industrial and manufacturing applications across Oman and the GCC region. Chemical additives are substances added in small quantities to a base material to improve or impart specific properties such as UV stability, antioxidant protection, anti-foaming, viscosity modification, corrosion inhibition, or anti-static behaviour. Our industrial additives portfolio serves coatings and paint manufacturers (defoamers, wetting agents, dispersants, rheology modifiers), plastics compounders (UV stabilisers, antioxidants, processing aids, flame retardants), lubricant formulators (VI improvers, pour point depressants, antiwear additives, extreme pressure agents), water treatment operations (antifoams, oxygen scavengers, pH buffers), and general industrial processes requiring performance-enhancing chemicals. Global Chemicals LLC sources additives from leading global specialty chemical manufacturers and supplies to Muscat, Sohar, Rusayl Industrial Area, Duqm, Salalah, and exports to UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain. Contact our technical team for specific additive requirements and recommendations.

faqs.question: What types of chemical additives does Global Chemicals LLC supply in Oman?
faqs.answer: Global Chemicals LLC supplies a broad range of industrial and specialty chemical additives for Oman's manufacturing, petrochemical, water treatment, and processing sectors. Additive categories include: corrosion inhibitors (film-forming amines, phosphonate packages, azole compounds for water treatment, oilfield, and industrial cooling systems); scale inhibitors and antiscalants (polyacrylate, HEDP, ATMP-based formulations for RO membranes, cooling towers, and boilers); defoamers and antifoam agents (silicone and non-silicone antifoams for fermentation, wastewater treatment, and process operations); biocides and preservatives (isothiazolinones, bronopol, DBNPA for industrial water systems and product preservation); viscosity modifiers (rheology control agents for drilling fluids, paints, and adhesives); dispersants and wetting agents (for coatings, pigment grinding, and water treatment); UV stabilisers for plastics and coatings; antioxidants for lubricants and fuels; and specialty surfactants for demulsification, emulsification, and foam control. Global Chemicals LLC provides technical support to match additive selection to customer process requirements and can supply in sample quantities for trials.

faqs.question: What antifoam and defoamer products are available for industrial use in Oman?
faqs.answer: Defoamers and antifoam agents prevent or destroy unwanted foam in industrial processes in Oman. Silicone defoamers (polydimethylsiloxane emulsions at 10–30% active content) are the most effective broad-spectrum antifoam agents — widely used in wastewater treatment plants, paper and pulp processing, fermentation, and textile processing, dosed at 50–500 ppm. They function by spreading over the foam bubble surface, reducing local surface tension and causing bubble rupture. Silicone defoamers are not suitable for food applications or where silicone contamination affects downstream processes (certain coatings, some polymer systems). Non-silicone defoamers based on mineral oil, fatty alcohol polyglycol ethers, or EO-PO block copolymers are preferred for food-grade, pharmaceutical, and painting applications. For Oman's water treatment and effluent plants, cost-effective mineral oil-based antifoam is standard. For higher-performance applications such as PDO wastewater injection plants or process separators, specialty polydimethylsiloxane defoamers provide superior performance at lower dosage rates. Global Chemicals LLC supplies both silicone and non-silicone defoamers in drum and IBC quantities for Oman.
